message.content:
This editorial illustration is a magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large white letters. Above the title, smaller black text reads "INVESTIGASI: ANTIKLIMAKS PSSI". Below the title is the date "3-9 MARET 2014". The primary subject is a man with short dark hair and glasses, wearing a dark long-sleeved shirt. He is shown from the waist up, leaning over a gray surface. His right hand is placing a gold crown onto a large white dome-shaped structure, which appears to be part of an LNG tanker constructed from interlocking plastic blocks. 

The ship has a black hull featuring a green and yellow circular logo with the letters "bp". Four large white domes run along the deck of the ship. On the gray surface nearby are scattered small plastic building blocks in red, blue, and gray. To the right of the man, large black text reads "LEGO GAS MENTERI JERO". Beneath this, smaller black text reads "NEGARA BISA RUGI TRILIUNAN RUPIAH DI GAS TANGGUH. LOBI TINGKAT TINGGI PEMERINTAH INGGRIS?". The The bottom right corner shows a barcode, the price "RP 35.000", and the website "WWW.TEMPO.CO".
